title: Pack the lab-avfull bundle (FLAG_32 run 2: AudioCLIP of every MAV-Celeb v1 / v2 face / voice row, CAFUSE-EN/feats_av_full ext_*); private

compute.note: original: ad-hoc local packaging 15/10/2026 18:06 (not timed); copies 117 MB and hashes it

origin.translates: the ad-hoc packaging of 15/10/2026 18:06 that made datasets/ngnnguynchn/flag2027-lab-avfull-p from Experiment/CAFUSE-EN/feats_av_full/ext_* (script lost, see original/SOURCE.json); same layout and manifest keys as kaggle/build_lab_bundle.py build_vb()

inputs.use: feats_av/ext_v{1,2}_complete_{face,voice}_{aclip,rows}.npy (found by file name; a saved copy may be the flat feats_av_full folder)

outputs.note: lab_avfull_dataset/labavfull/* = the dataset content (consumers mount it at datasets/ngnnguynchn/flag2027-lab-avfull-p); bundle_report.json = sha256 of every member, comparison with the frozen dataset, guard decision
outputs.licence: features of MAV-Celeb v1 / v2 (organisers' data, challenge terms); private, shared only with the organisers through FF_DATA, never in the repository

variant.lora_c1: not_used (AudioCLIP feature bundle; no LoRA C1 input)

guard_policy.check: sha256 of the 8 npy files == expected_members.json (the frozen dataset, package E:); labavfull/lab_manifest.json is not compared (creation time)

overrides.FF_ALLOW_MISMATCH=1: warn in any mode (aclip and rows)

guard_policy.read_by: the stage's own cell 3 (FF_STAGE_DIR/stage.json; FF_MODE is set by the runner)
guard_policy.why: same policy as l_groups / l_dqual_g3 / l_lid_audit / l_lid_strict for the AudioCLIP arrays: FLAG_32 is a GPU run (fp16 autocast for faces) that is not bit-identical when re-run, so FF_MODE=train warns; infer / assemble only ever copy the frozen arrays, so a difference there is an error. The *_rows.npy files are arange(N) of the ext-meta tables: a difference means other MAV-Celeb rows (misaligned arrays), so it fails in every mode unless FF_ALLOW_MISMATCH=1

verify.why: no member beyond the original's (warning only)

all 8 npy files byte-identical to the frozen dataset (expected with the frozen f32 output or the skip_with copy; after a FLAG_32 GPU re-run the aclip arrays differ: warning only, the guard in cell 3 decides)

post_checks.why: every member of the original dataset (expected_members.json) is in the new bundle
row files int64 arange(N) with the ext-meta row counts 7 580 / 19 556 / 8 953 / 20 715; aclip arrays float16 (N, 1024), finite

consumers: e112f0sx (mount datasets/ngnnguynchn/flag2027-lab-avfull-p; OPTIONAL_DIRS CAFUSE-EN/feats_av_full: AudioCLIP arrays of EN-T3-01 table_en on the F0 English path; F0 English reaches f1s_eval.zip but not the 13.54 zip)
notes: Not byte-identical as a dataset: labavfull/lab_manifest.json carries the build time; every other member is compared.
Without FF_FORCE=f32_aclip_full the input may be the skip_with view of f32_aclip_full (the frozen feats_av_full folder): the bundle is then the frozen content and the guard passes.
